verdict.rationale: Perplexity publishes a machine-readable OpenAPI spec at docs.perplexity.ai/openapi.json and has structured API docs, including an Agent API quickstart and llms.txt/markdown docs. These are the building blocks of an API reference. However, nothing in the evidence shows the reference is interactive or that examples can be run in the browser. Missing for 10: evidence of an interactive API explorer or playground, runnable in-docs request examples, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
